finalText:
Redis went down and took prod with it.

02:14:07 `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`. Cache fell back to direct store reads.
Timeouts started at once. Queue depth climbed 52 to 568. Max is 500.
All 13 reconnect tries failed. 02:31:44 worker-2 hit `JavaScript heap out of memory (request backlog)`.
02:31:52 supervisor killed the api process group. Service down.

Fix Redis first. Everything else follows from it.
